lines.en: label makiday351:
scene makimalldate1
: So...what exactly was it you wanted to talk to me about?
lines.zh: : 那么……你到底想跟我谈什么？

lines.en: Maki and I walk silently through the halls of the mall for a short while and I can’t help but notice her looking a little distracted.
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 沉默着在商场里走了一会儿，我忍不住注意到她看起来有点心不在焉。

lines.en: I don’t know if that’s just her tell for wanting me to buy her something but, if it is, she is in for a very rude awakening.
lines.zh: 我不知道那是不是她想让我给她买东西时的表情，不过如果是，她可要被现实狠狠上一课了。

lines.en: : Nothing in particular. I just figured you’d rather be spending time with someone who’s actually your age than following around a bunch of [teens].
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。我只是觉得，你大概更愿意跟一个跟你年纪相仿的人待在一起，而不是跟着一群 [teens] 后面转。

lines.en: scene makimalldate2
: It’s one thing to fill up on[teen]porn but, as a former [teenager] myself, I can confirm that almost all of them are confusing and irritating and-
lines.zh: : 光是看[teen]色情是一回事，但作为一个曾经的 [teenager]，我可以确认他们几乎全都让人摸不着头脑、惹人烦，而且-

lines.en: : Exhausting.
lines.zh: : 累人。

lines.en: : Yes. That as well.
lines.zh: : 对。这个也是。

lines.en: scene makimalldate3
: Are you sure it’s okay to be saying that when you have a [teenage]daughter, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你有个 [teenage]女儿，说这种话真没问题吗？

lines.en: : Are you afraid she’ll jump out from behind a mannequin and call me a bad mother or something?
lines.zh: : 你怕她从模特假人后面跳出来，骂我是个坏妈妈之类的？

lines.en: : Well it’s not like you two really have the best relationship to begin with, right?
lines.zh: : 反正你们俩的关系本来也算不上多好，对吧？

lines.en: scene makimalldate4
: Makoto and me? I think our relationship is great.
lines.zh: : 我和 Makoto？我觉得我们的关系好极了。

lines.en: : It’s true that I have a hard time deciding how to tackle certain things, but as long as I have you as my stand-in husband until mine stops fucking aliens, I think everything will turn out just fine.
lines.zh: : 我确实有些事情拿不准该怎么处理，不过只要在我那位还在操外星人期间有你来当我的替补丈夫，我觉得一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : Woah there. I never agreed to this whole “stand-in husband” thing.
lines.zh: : 喂喂。我可从没答应过什么「替补丈夫」。

lines.en: scene makimalldate5
: Not five minutes into our marriage and you’re already asking for a divorce?
lines.zh: : 我们结婚还不到五分钟，你就想离婚了？

lines.en: : Is it because you have to go to space? Because I’m already used to that and don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 是因为你得去太空吗？因为那我早就习惯了，一点都不介意。

lines.en: : Enjoy your alien sex.
lines.zh: : 那你就好好享受外星人性爱吧。

lines.en: : Every day, your existence somehow manages to make me even more impressed by the head your daughter has on her shoulders.
lines.zh: : 每一天，你的存在都让我对你女儿长在肩膀上的那个脑袋更加佩服。

lines.en: : Well as long as it’s up there and not pressed between someone’s knees, I’m totally happy.
lines.zh: : 只要它还在上面，没被夹在别人的膝盖之间，我就心满意足了。

lines.en: : I would like to take this opportunity to reiterate my previous statement.
lines.zh: : 我想借这个机会重申我刚才说过的话。

lines.en: scene makimalldate6
: Jokes aside, I’m glad that Makoto seems to be going back to her old self as of late.
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，我很高兴 Makoto 最近似乎变回了从前的自己。

lines.en: : Actually, strike that. She seems truly happy for the first time since her father left as of late.
lines.zh: : 不，收回那句。她看起来是她父亲离开之后第一次真正地快乐。

lines.en: : Really? Because she kind of suffered a crushing defeat during her dorm wars contest thing and I thought it might get to her.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？她前阵子在那场宿舍大战比赛里可是惨败了，我还以为那会影响她。

lines.en: scene makimalldate7
: Did you talk to her about it?
lines.zh: : 你跟她谈过那件事吗？

lines.en: : I didn’t see any reason to. That’s not something I should really get involved in.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没理由谈。那不是我真该插手的事。

lines.en: : Well {i}I{/i} did, so ha.
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}谈过了，哼。

lines.en: : Wow. Look at you being a real mom.
lines.zh: : 哇。看看你，真像个妈妈了。

lines.en: : I’ll have you know there’s not any minute of any day that I’m not a mom before anything else.
lines.zh: : 我告诉你，任何一天的任何一分钟，我都先是妈妈，再是别的什么。

lines.en: : It’s just a little difficult when your child imprints on your significant other instead of you.
lines.zh: : 只是当你的孩子依恋上的不是你、而是你的另一半时，就有点难办了。

lines.en: scene makimalldate8
: But I digress.
lines.zh: : 不过我扯远了。

lines.en: : Makoto’s knowledge test thing crashing and burning may have even been good for her in a way.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，Makoto 那场知识竞赛摔得那么惨，说不定对她反倒是好事。

lines.en: : I don’t want to call it a wake up call or a...rude awakening or...any other phrase that involves waking up-
lines.zh: : 我不想说那是什么警钟或者……当头棒喝……或者任何跟「醒过来」有关的说法-

lines.en: : But it’s kind of good to get the shit kicked out of you every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 但偶尔被人打得满地找牙，其实也挺有好处的。

lines.en: : Are you asking me to mug your daughter?
lines.zh: : 你是在要我去打劫你女儿吗？

lines.en: : You’ll have to go through me first, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那你得先过我这关，老师。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound very hard.
lines.zh: : 听起来不难啊。

lines.en: : We’d probably get turned on while wrestling and wind up taking each other’s clothes off.
lines.zh: : 我们大概会在扭打的时候来了感觉，最后把彼此的衣服都脱光。

lines.en: : You know, maybe I {i}will{/i} mug your daughter after all.
lines.zh: : 这么一说，也许我{i}还真要{/i}去打劫你女儿了。

lines.en: scene makimalldate9
: Ahh, the things we do for love.
lines.zh: : 唉，我们为爱所做的这些事啊。

lines.en: : Please don’t love me. There is not a single person we know who would approve of this relationship.
lines.zh: : 求你别爱我。我们认识的人里没有一个会赞成这段关系。

lines.en: : Miku might.
lines.zh: : Miku 说不定会。

lines.en: : Miku is on Team Makoto now.
lines.zh: : Miku 现在站 Makoto 队了。

lines.en: : As in she’s rooting for you to fall in love with my daughter?
lines.zh: : 你是说她支持你跟我女儿谈恋爱？

lines.en: : It appears that way.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样。

lines.en: : It appears that a spanking may be in order then.
lines.zh: : 那看来是时候打一顿屁股了。

lines.en: : For me or for Miku?
lines.zh: : 打我还是打 Miku？

lines.en: : I don’t really want to be spanked.
lines.zh: : 我可不太想被打屁股。

lines.en: : That’s what my actual husband thought at first.
lines.zh: : 我真正的丈夫一开始也是这么想的。

lines.en: : Be careful. Anything you say right now may one day be used against Makoto to embarrass her in front of class.
lines.zh: : 小心点。你现在说的任何话，有朝一日都可能被用来对付 Makoto，在全班面前让她难堪。

lines.en: scene makimalldate10
: Oh please. She’s such a daddy’s girl that she could have walked in on me spanking him and still pinned the whole thing on me just...being too dominant.
lines.zh: : 拜托。她那么恋父，就算撞见我在打他屁股，也会把整件事归结为我……支配欲太强。

lines.en: : But to everyone's surprise, I'm actually an innocent and pure sub at heart.
lines.zh: : 不过让所有人意外的是，我内心其实是个纯洁无辜的受方。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t believe that for one second.
lines.zh: : 哈，我一个字都不信。

lines.en: scene makimalldate11
: Okay, fine. I was lying.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。我刚才是骗你的。

lines.en: : But in my defense, being dominant is basically where all of my experience is.
lines.zh: : 不过替我自己说句公道话，我的经验基本都在「支配」这边。

lines.en: : I haven’t really gotten many chances to play out any of my submissive fantasies because of my husband’s love for spanking and petplay.
lines.zh: : 因为我老公热爱打屁股和宠物扮演，我一直没多少机会实践自己的顺从幻想。

lines.en: : Having someone like you as a pet does sound like it would have its perks.
lines.zh: : 把像你这样的人当宠物养，听起来确实有不少好处。

lines.en: : Oh, no. He was the pet.
lines.zh: : 哦不，他才是宠物。

lines.en: : We had a leash and everything.
lines.zh: : 我们连牵引绳都有，一应俱全。

lines.en: scene makimalldate12
: Anyway.
lines.zh: : 总之。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Makoto. It looks like your classmates may soon find out that your father had a very different side than the one you grew up with.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Makoto。看来你的同学们很快就要发现，你父亲有一面跟你从小认识的那个他完全不同。

lines.en: scene black
Maki and I do a lap or two around the mall and manage to avoid contact with the group of girls I split up with earlier.
lines.zh: 我和 Maki 在商场里逛了一两圈，成功避开了早先跟我分开的那群女孩。

lines.en: I’m not sure if the three of them have already gone home, but it’s starting to get dark and Maki is showing no signs of ending our gathering just yet.
lines.zh: 我不确定她们三个是不是已经回家了，不过天开始黑了，Maki 却一点要结束这次聚会的意思都没有。

lines.en: I pull out my phone to text Ami about missing dinner but realize that she’s likely still with Ayane anyway-
lines.zh: 我掏出手机想给 Ami 发消息说不回去吃晚饭，却意识到她大概还跟 Ayane 在一起-

lines.en: So it looks like I’ll be able to dodge all suspicion entirely tonight and get to continue hanging out with a MILF.
lines.zh: 所以看来今晚我可以完全避开所有怀疑，继续跟一个熟女妈妈厮混。

lines.en: Nice.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: scene makimalldate13
: Hey...can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : 嘿……我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : You’re just going to ask anyway, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 反正你不管怎样都会问的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. You said something that kind of made me upset earlier and I wanted to bring it up again before I hate myself for letting it go.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你之前说的某句话让我有点难受，我想在恨自己就这么算了之前，再把它提出来。

lines.en: : You don’t actually think I’m a bad mother, do you?
lines.zh: : 你其实并不觉得我是个坏妈妈吧？

lines.en: : Because I’ve exhausted pretty much every resource available for Makoto. She’s just too annoyingly smart to really {i}need{/i} someone like me.
lines.zh: : 因为我为 Makoto 已经几乎用尽了所有能用的办法。她就是聪明得气人，根本不太{i}需要{/i}我这样的人。

lines.en: : I didn’t really mean that. I was just using your words against you, really.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我只是拿你说过的话反过来堵你而已。

lines.en: : I don’t remember ever calling myself a bad mother. That hurt.
lines.zh: : 我不记得自己说过我是坏妈妈。这话伤人。

lines.en: : No. But you said that you might try to approach things more like a friend at times.
lines.zh: : 没有。但你说过，有时候你会试着更像朋友那样去处理事情。

lines.en: : And there’s also the issue of your...complicated relationship dynamic with your husband.
lines.zh: : 还有你跟你丈夫之间……复杂的相处模式也是个问题。

lines.en: : Spanking your husband makes you a bad mom?
lines.zh: : 打你丈夫屁股就算坏妈妈了？

lines.en: : What? No. The whole open relationship thing.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。是那段开放式关系的事。

lines.en: : What does that have to do with Makoto?
lines.zh: : 那跟 Makoto 有什么关系？

lines.en: : Well...can you really say her environment was “normal” growing up?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你真能说她成长的环境是「正常」的吗？

lines.en: scene makimalldate14
: I can, actually.
lines.zh: : 我能，真的。

lines.en: : Do you think we let her run around the store and use vibrators as rattles? Let her watch gangbang videos in the backroom while we kept an eye on the front?
lines.zh: : 你以为我们会让她在店里乱跑、拿振动棒当拨浪鼓玩？让她在后间看群交录像，我们在前头盯着店？

lines.en: : Do you think she was present for all of the times her father insisted on bringing a new girl home?
lines.zh: : 你以为她父亲每次非要带新女孩回家的时候，她都在场？

lines.en: : Or do you think I, as a competent but slightly confused mother, would have kept my little girl away from that as best as I could?
lines.zh: : 还是说你觉得我这个还算称职、只是偶尔有点迷糊的母亲，会尽我所能让我的小女儿远离那些？

lines.en: : I think that Makoto is perceptive enough to figure things out even when they’re not right in front of her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Makoto 的洞察力足够强，就算事情没摆在眼前，她也能自己琢磨明白。

lines.en: : And I think that she’s the type of person to measure her circumstances against those of others to try and figure out what “normalcy” is.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得她是那种会拿自己的处境跟别人比较，好弄清「正常」到底是什么的人。

lines.en: : So I’m a bad mother because my daughter is a genius?
lines.zh: : 所以我女儿是个天才，我就成了坏妈妈？

lines.en: : I already told you I didn’t mean that.
lines.zh: : 我说过了我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Well then apologize.
lines.zh: : 那就道歉。

lines.en: scene makimalldate15
: Hey. If you’re going to be my stand-in husband, you’re going to have to realize when you’re in the wrong.
lines.zh: : 嘿。既然你要当我的替补丈夫，那你就得知道自己什么时候错了。

lines.en: : I never agreed to-
lines.zh: : 我从来没答应过-

lines.en: : You don’t have to. Makoto’s already chosen you as her stand-in daddy, so now it’s all on you to live up to it.
lines.zh: : 你不用答应。Makoto 已经选你当她的替补爸爸了，所以现在全看你能不能配得上这个身份。

lines.en: : Can you call me daddy again please?
lines.zh: : 你能再叫我一声爸爸吗？

lines.en: : Daddy.
lines.zh: : 爸爸。

lines.en: : A little softer this time.
lines.zh: : 这次温柔一点。

lines.en: scene makimalldate16
: {i}Daddy...{/i}
: Now do it like you’re about to cum.
lines.zh: : 现在用快要高潮的语气再来一次。

lines.en: scene makimalldate17
: Ahh! Daddy! Yes! Yes!
lines.zh: : 啊！爸爸！对！对！

lines.en: : Wow.
lines.zh: 哇。

lines.en: scene makimalldate18
: Teehee~
lines.zh: 嘻嘻~

lines.en: : There are a bunch of people looking this way now.
lines.zh: : 现在有好多人往这边看了。

lines.en: : Of course there are. I just came on a bench in a mall.
lines.zh: : 那当然。我刚在商场长椅上高潮了。

lines.en: : Did you actually-
lines.zh: 你真的-

lines.en: scene makimalldate19
: God, no. If it were that easy, I’d literally never leave home.
lines.zh: : 天哪，没有。要是有那么容易，我这辈子都不会出门了。

lines.en: : Well it was very convincing and I hope for your husband’s sake that he never fell victim to your deceit.
lines.zh: : 嗯，演得非常有说服力。为了你丈夫着想，我希望他从没被你的演技骗到过。

lines.en: : If he knew the amount of times he’d been deceived, I really {i}would{/i} need a new husband.
lines.zh: : 要是他知道被骗了多少次，我就{i}真得{/i}换个新丈夫了。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to keep it a secret if he ever returns from the alien orgy.
lines.zh: : 等他从那场外星狂欢里回来，我一定替你保密。

lines.en: scene makimalldate20
: Oh. I didn’t mean it like-
lines.zh: : 哦。我不是那个意思-

lines.en: : No, no. I get it. I just don’t like hearing it out loud.
lines.zh: : 不，不。我明白。我只是不喜欢听人说出口而已。

lines.en: : The truth is that...and don’t tell Makoto I said this-
lines.zh: : 事实是……而且别告诉 Makoto 这是我说的-

lines.en: : But...I don’t really want to wind up waiting forever.
lines.zh: : 但是……我其实不想就这样永远等下去。

lines.en: : I miss my husband. I really do.
lines.zh: : 我想我丈夫。真的想。

lines.en: : But there’s a point where you have to sort of just accept that things might not turn out how you wanted them to turn out.
lines.zh: : 但到了某个时候，你总得多少接受一件事：事情也许不会照你想要的方向发展。

lines.en: : It’s painful not hearing from someone for years. Especially someone you spent so many years {i}with{/i}.
lines.zh: : 好些年没有一个人的音讯，是很痛苦的。尤其是那个人你曾经{i}相伴{/i}了那么多年。

lines.en: : But I can’t do everything on my own.
lines.zh: : 可我不能什么都自己扛。

lines.en: scene makimalldate21
: I’m not like Sara or Haruka. I’m willing to accept my shortcomings and don’t want them to weigh me down.
lines.zh: : 我不像 Sara 或 Haruka。我愿意承认自己的不足，也不想让它们拖垮我。

lines.en: : I’ve got a genius daughter to take care of. And, like you said earlier, she’s perceptive enough to realize things I don’t want her to.
lines.zh: : 我有个天才女儿要照顾。而且就像你刚才说的，她的洞察力强到能察觉我不希望她察觉的事。

lines.en: : The second I start killing myself by working even harder is the second she starts killing herself as well.
lines.zh: : 从我为了更拼命工作而把自己逼死的那一刻起，她也会开始把自己逼死。

lines.en: : Well-
: And this isn’t me agreeing to be Makoto’s new father-
lines.zh: : 而且这不是我答应要当 Makoto 的新爸爸-

lines.en: : But I’ll wind up supporting you in whatever you decide to do.
lines.zh: : 但不管你最后怎么决定，我都会支持你。

lines.en: scene makimalldate22
: Oh my God. Did you just agree to become Makoto’s new father?
lines.zh: : 我的天。你刚才是不是答应要做 Makoto 的新爸爸了？

lines.en: : Maki, I specifically stated-
lines.zh: : Maki，我刚才明确说了-

lines.en: scene makimalldate23
: Makoto’s going to be so happy that she won’t even mind hearing me yell “Daddy” over and over from the back room all night!
lines.zh: : Makoto 一定会高兴得，哪怕整晚都听见我在后间一遍遍喊「爸爸」，她也不会在意！

lines.en: : No, I very much think she would mind that.
lines.zh: : 不，我非常确定她会在意。

lines.en: scene makimalldate24
: Thank you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，老师。

lines.en: : Not for the father thing, but for the support.
lines.zh: : 不是为当爸爸那件事，是为你的支持。

lines.en: : You’ve done so much for Makoto and me in such a short time that I can’t help but feel like we owe a lot of ourselves to you.
lines.zh: : 你在这么短的时间里为我和 Makoto 做了这么多，我忍不住觉得我们欠了你很多。

lines.en: : Is that-
lines.zh: : 那是-

lines.en: : For once, I don’t mean that sexually.
lines.zh: : 就这一次，我不是在说性方面的意思。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : I mean that, in some way or another, you just being you is enough to keep Makoto afloat.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，不管怎么说，光是你做你自己，就足够让 Makoto 浮在水面上。

lines.en: : And Makoto being afloat means that I get to be afloat.
lines.zh: : 而 Makoto 浮着，就意味着我也能浮着。

lines.en: : And before we know it, we’re all on the same raft together.
lines.zh: : 不知不觉间，我们就都在同一条筏子上了。

lines.en: : Floating past nudist colonies and shielding that pure girl’s eyes from the things you and I as perverts see in our dreams.
lines.zh: : 漂过一个个天体营，替那个纯洁的女孩挡住你我这两个变态在梦里才会看见的东西。

lines.en: I’m glad that Makoto is also smart enough to not reveal to her mother that she’s in an ongoing illicit relationship with her teacher.
lines.zh: 幸好 Makoto 也足够聪明，没跟她母亲透露自己正跟老师维持着一段不正当关系。

lines.en: I figure that must be difficult to do, but so many of my students are missing parents that it’s honestly hard to say.
lines.zh: 我想那一定很难做到，不过我的学生里有那么多缺失父母的人，说真的也难讲。

lines.en: scene makimalldate25
: I’m not suggesting anything here, but...
lines.zh: : 我在这儿并没有暗示什么，不过……

lines.en: : Even if my husband does wind up coming back, I hope you’ll stick around.
lines.zh: : 就算我丈夫最后真的回来了，我也希望你能留下来。

lines.en: : If not for me, then for Makoto.
lines.zh: : 就算不为我，也是为 Makoto。

lines.en: : She really needs you.
lines.zh: : 她真的很需要你。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我尽量吧。

lines.en: scene black
Of course I have no intention of just skipping town and abandoning the Miyamuras...but it’s not like I could even if I wanted to.
lines.zh: 我当然没打算就这么远走高飞、把 Miyamura 家的人抛下……不过就算我想，也走不掉。

lines.en: The truth is that even though Maki and Makoto couldn’t be further apart in terms of personality, they’re still two of three cerberian heads.
lines.zh: 事实是，尽管 Maki 和 Makoto 在性格上简直是天差地别，她们仍然是三头犬中的两个头。

lines.en: The third, however, has been severed and is now floating somewhere out in space.
lines.zh: 然而第三个头已经被斩断，此刻正漂浮在太空中的某个地方。

lines.en: Maybe fucking aliens, maybe not.
lines.zh: 也许在操外星人，也许没有。

lines.en: There’s no way of knowing.
lines.zh: 无从得知。

lines.en: But at least I know that the other two heads are [[probably] safe for the indeterminate future.
lines.zh: 但至少我知道，另外两个头在无法确定的未来里 [[probably] 是安全的。
